title: Coffee Reference

keyPoints: Comprehensive coffee reference covering various aspects.
Organized into sections like Coffee Basics, Categories, Health, Crop to Cup, Culture, and Espresso.
Includes information on tasting, origins, roasting, blending, caffeine, brewing, and cultural significance.
analysis.summary: This is a comprehensive coffee reference guide adapted from Kenneth Davids' books. It covers a wide range of topics including coffee basics, categories, health aspects, the journey from crop to cup, coffee culture, and espresso. The guide provides information on various aspects of coffee, from its history and language to brewing methods and cultural significance, making it a valuable resource for coffee enthusiasts.
